# ASIG 0.5.1 accessibility evidence

This patch release covers the shared solid action fallback used when a browser or consumer
suppresses CSS background images, plus contrast-safe form-control boundaries. It does not claim
that ERP, OpenCAD, or Marketing adapters conform before those products repeat the checks in
their own routes and themes.

## Automated evidence

The release candidate must pass these commands on Node.js 26 before publication:

```sh
npm run check
npm test
```

The focused browser regression removes gradients from Primary and Destructive actions and
verifies that their solid Operations-theme backgrounds and foregrounds remain readable. Every
theme also receives a second Axe scan with gradients and backdrop filters disabled, so scanner
incompletes caused by decorative effects cannot hide a failing solid fallback. Known hidden
`aria-controls` relationships are narrowly allowlisted by exact target while their referenced
IDs remain statically validated. Token validation requires 3:1 control-boundary contrast against
both the input and surrounding surfaces.

Results recorded on 2026-09-17:

- `npm run check`: passed with theme, pattern, markup, generated-token, deterministic-snapshot,
  and package-content validation;
- focused solid action fallback test: 4 passed at 375px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px;
- `npm test`: 96 passed, 24 intentional viewport-specific skips, 0 failed; and
- package contents: both public packages passed `npm pack --dry-run` through `npm run check`.

An automated pass is regression evidence, not a WCAG conformance declaration.

## Manual verification

| Check | Status for this candidate | Reviewer evidence required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Solid action fallback with gradients suppressed | Original failure confirmed on the affected managed browser; packaged-release retest pending | Confirm Primary and Destructive labels remain visible in the ERP after adopting 0.5.1. |
| Keyboard-only navigation and visible focus | Existing automated coverage; final human review pending | Confirm order and focus visibility in a supported browser. |
| Light and dark visual review | Pending human review | Confirm the fallback does not change normal gradient rendering in either theme. |
| 200 percent text and 400 percent zoom equivalent | Existing automated coverage; human review pending | Confirm no lost content or functionality in a supported browser. |
| Forced colors and reduced motion/transparency | Existing automated coverage; human review pending | Confirm meaning and boundaries remain visible with OS preferences enabled. |
| Screen reader and browser combination | Pending human review | Confirm names, roles, states, and announcements remain unchanged. |

Do not describe this release or any consuming product as accessibility-complete until the
pending human checks are dated and signed off by a reviewer.
